propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes resolved-status names instead of reading from config, whereas DC reconciler sources them from ReconcilerConfig.resolved_statuses, creating feature parity gap.
A tenant using non-standard workflow statuses (e.g. 'Closed', 'Complete') cannot customize which statuses trigger PRESENT_RESOLVED classification without code changes.
JiraConfig must expose a configurable resolved_statuses list defaulting to ['Resolved', 'Done', 'Cancelled'] parsed from [tool.rebar.jira] with REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override.
classify_probe_response must resolve the configured set at runtime via load_config().jira.resolved_statuses, falling back to module-level RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES when unset, empty, or malformed.

Custom resolved-status config must be consulted exclusively (not merged with defaults) so a tenant can restrict classification scope, and empty config must fall back to defaults rather than bind an empty set.
